visual_action: Joe Biden sits at a table and wishes viewers a 'Happy National Coffee Day' via on-screen text. He takes a sip from a white mug, then says, 'I like my coffee dark.' The video then cuts to a close-up of the mug, which has a graphic of Biden's face and the years '20 24'. Red laser-like beams are digitally added to the eyes of the Biden graphic on the mug.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: Joe Biden is shown on screen speaking directly to the camera.

cast.name: Dark Brandon
cast.evidence: The video culminates in a close-up of a mug with Joe Biden's image, whose eyes are manipulated to glow red, a visual hallmark of the 'Dark Brandon' meme, immediately after Biden says 'I like my coffee dark.'

spoken_summary: Joe Biden says, "I like my coffee dark."
audio_music: The video starts with only dialogue. After Biden speaks and the camera focuses on the mug, a loud, bass-heavy, intense hip-hop/trap beat suddenly starts playing, creating a dramatic, hype-filled effect.
editing_pacing: The video is a single static shot of Joe Biden speaking, which then cuts to a close-up zoom on the coffee mug for the punchline.
manipulation_or_satire: Red glowing beams are digitally superimposed over the eyes of the Joe Biden graphic on the coffee mug to evoke the 'Dark Brandon' meme.
central_claim: Joe Biden is embracing the 'Dark Brandon' meme, using a pun about coffee to portray himself as a powerful and formidable figure.
intended_effect: To amuse supporters and portray Biden as powerful and culturally relevant by participating in a popular internet meme.
